title: 79% of employed respondents would sacrifice salary for protection against AI job displacement: Report
script:
Seventy-nine percent of employed workers would sacrifice part of their salary to protect their jobs from AI displacement.
The finding comes from a major workplace report published by ET CIO detailing growing automation fears.
Employees are actively rethinking their financial stability as software begins handling complex daily office tasks.
Professionals now view pay cuts as an acceptable insurance policy against getting replaced by modern algorithms.
Would you take a permanent pay reduction to guarantee your career safety?
